formulas.ascii: z(u) = sum(z_i / d_i^p) / sum(1 / d_i^p), taper=none. N contains up to k nearest unmasked non-NaN samples within inclusive radius R and index bounds, ordered by (distance², row). An exact hit returns the smallest-row sample; without an exact hit, fewer than max(minimumNeighborCount, 1) contributors gives NaN. Log-space accumulation rescales weights without changing the normalized mean.
